policies.title: Macao SAR passports: named visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Macao DSI's current passport-specific records classify Bosnia and Herzegovina, British Virgin Islands, Mali and Kosovo Area as visa-free rather than arrival-visa access.
conditions: This applies only to the Macao SAR Passport, not to a PRC passport, Hong Kong document, Portuguese passport or another Chinese travel document.

Maximum stays stated by DSI are 90 days for Bosnia and Herzegovina, Mali and Kosovo Area, and six months for the British Virgin Islands. The DSI's Kosovo Area label records the visa route but does not resolve recognition, routing or border-operation questions.
Purpose, passport validity, carrier requirements and final admission remain subject to the destination authorities.

policies.title: Macao SAR passports: Tunisia conditional visa-free tourist-group entry
policies.summary: Macao DSI records visa-free entry to Tunisia for qualifying Macao SAR Passport tourist groups.
conditions: The exemption is limited to a tourist group of at least five people that has valid travel documents, prepaid hotel accommodation and round-trip air tickets.
The DSI record states a maximum stay of 30 days. Individual travellers, different purposes, carrier requirements and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Macao SAR passports: Comoros arrival visa
policies.summary: Macao DSI's current passport-specific Comoros record marks visa-on-arrival, not visa-free access.
conditions: The DSI record gives a maximum stay of 45 days and classifies the route as visa on arrival.
This is for the Macao SAR Passport only. Purpose, travel-document validity, carrier checks, fees and final admission remain subject to Comorian authorities.

policies.title: Macao SAR passports: named electronic visitor visas
policies.summary: Macao DSI's current passport-specific records place Djibouti, Iraq, South Sudan and Ukraine in its expressly labelled e-visa route, with neither visa-free nor arrival-visa access marked.
conditions: The DSI records mark evisa: 1 and visaFree/visaOnArrival: 0 for each named destination; this is an expressly classified electronic-visa route, not an inference from the existence of an online application.

The South Sudan and Ukraine destination authorities expressly confirm electronic issuance before departure. Use the linked destination official e-visa service before travel; purpose, duration, documents, fees, carrier requirements, operational availability and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Macao DSI travel-convenience service (links to each destination's official e-visa route)
steps: Confirm the current Macao SAR Passport record and select the linked official destination e-visa service for the intended destination.
Apply and obtain the electronic visitor visa before departure under the destination's current requirements.
Travel with the resulting authorization and comply with carrier and final-admission requirements.

policies.title: Macao SAR passports: Gabon electronic preapproval and arrival visa
policies.summary: Macao DSI lists Gabon in its e-visa field for the Macao SAR Passport, but Gabon's DGDI says the prior electronic travel authorization is followed by delivery of the visa sticker on arrival.
conditions: Obtain the DGDI Travel Authorization Receipt before departure; the destination portal warns against travelling before receiving it.
The e-visa sticker is delivered and paid for on arrival at Libreville Leon Mba International Airport. This is not a generally border-available visa without the prior authorization.

application.label: Gabon DGDI electronic travel authorization
steps: Apply online and wait for the Travel Authorization Receipt before travelling.
Enter by air through Libreville Leon Mba International Airport and receive/pay for the visa sticker on arrival.
